_comment: Public release-state interface. This file is the ONLY release-gating input the public repository consumes. It carries four generic states and no case history: which reviews were run, by whom, under which internal identifiers, and against which evidence is deliberately not represented here. A state is PASS only when the corresponding private evidence legitimately supports it; the default is PENDING and the interface is fail-closed.

semantic_review.meaning: Independent review of the model's structure and claims is complete and its findings are resolved or explicitly accepted.

coauthor_approval.meaning: Every co-author has consented to the release of this exact artifact, identified by digest.

governance_clearance.meaning: All programme prerequisites for release are closed and no hold is active.

founder_release_authorization.meaning: Release of this exact artifact is explicitly authorized.

policy.rule: A state may be PASS only when every private prerequisite mapped to it is itself satisfied. The weakest prerequisite determines the public state: no averaging, no partial credit.
policy.evidence_location: Detailed prerequisites, their evidence and their mapping to these four states are held privately and are not part of the public interface.
